question: For one normalized scalar zonal harmonic subspace on the unit three-sphere and one finite cutoff L=2, what exact product coefficients survive projection and what normed product remainder is discarded?

primary_sources.source: A.Yu. Kamenshchik and S.L. Lyakhovich, Hamiltonian BFV-BRST theory of closed quantum cosmological models, Nucl. Phys. B495 (1997) 309-338, arXiv:hep-th/9608130v1
primary_sources.used_for: closed-model harmonic-expansion and BFV motivation only
primary_sources.not_used_for: the zonal normalization, a V0 action, a constraint algebra, BRST nilpotency, anomaly freedom, or a physical state

primary_sources.source: J.J. Halliwell and S.W. Hawking, Origin of structure in the Universe, Phys. Rev. D31 (1985) 1777
primary_sources.not_used_for: a transfer of no-boundary, inflationary, gauge, or perturbative assumptions into this algebraic ledger

primary_sources.source: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, Chapter 18, Orthogonal Polynomials
primary_sources.used_for: Gegenbauer-polynomial differential-equation and normalization convention cross-checks
primary_sources.not_used_for: a full scalar-vector-tensor harmonic completeness theorem, ADM constraints, or HDA closure

declared_geometry_and_basis.manifold: unit S3 with geodesic polar coordinate chi in [0,pi] and volume dV=sin(chi)^2 dchi dOmega_2
declared_geometry_and_basis.zonal_basis: Z_n(chi)=(2*pi^2)^(-1/2) C_n^(1)(cos chi)=(2*pi^2)^(-1/2) sin((n+1)chi)/sin(chi), n>=0, with endpoint values defined by continuity
declared_geometry_and_basis.symmetry_control: the antipodal isometry acts as chi -> pi-chi and Z_n -> (-1)^n Z_n; every retained product coefficient obeys l+m-n even

tasks: derive exact zonal orthonormality from the unit-S3 volume measure
verify the scalar Laplacian eigenvalue equation for n=0,1,2,3,4
verify the exact finite Gegenbauer character product identity for all l,m<=2
compute P_2(Z_l Z_m) and the orthogonal remainder for all l,m<=2
record exact remainder norms and exhibit Z_2 Z_2 as a nonzero omitted Z_4 witness
verify antipodal parity and parity compatibility of every declared product coefficient
verify a projected-product associator witness and compare it with the explicitly retained remainder ledger
leave all canonical, vector/tensor, HDA, BFV, anomaly, relational, empirical and physical conclusions null

decision_table.condition: all exact basis, Laplacian, product, projection, remainder, parity and associator identities pass
